architecture.summary: Probe tooling only: script/spike/gateway-proxy-probe.ts and its helper modules under script/spike/gateway-proxy/ model the MCP gateway in one local process (a stand-in upstream that checks a signed Thermus-Access header, a proxy that signs, streams, and passes the abort, and an SDK client), and knip lists the script as an entry point. No source, runtime, registry view, declaration, or deployment changes; the Slice 1 evidence record has the SO-01d section with the measured times, the findings, and the limits.
